summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing that certain insiders, led by its CEO, acquired 90,882 common shares on the open market between May 6-8, 2026 at an average price of $3.39 per share. Following these purchases, insiders and consultants collectively hold 7,720,360 shares, or approximately 8.8% of outstanding stock. The disclosure is a routine report of insider transactions, per Form 6-K requirements for foreign private issuers. No tender, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved. The transaction reflects insider confidence but does not constitute a special-situations event.
